label: Basins of attraction
subgoals: Find the stationary points as the roots of the derivative
Classify them by the sign change of the derivative
Follow the descent direction from the start to the nearest minimum in its basin

label: What breaks convexity
subgoals: Test a feasible set by checking segments between feasible points
Check every quadratic constraint matrix for semidefiniteness
Flag either-or rules, discrete sets and nonlinear equalities as nonconvex

label: Strategies for nonconvex problems
subgoals: Choose continuation, multi-start, relaxation or annealing for the problem
Escape a saddle along a negative-curvature direction
Judge a local optimum against baselines and bounds
